honestyNotes: All values are synthetic fixture model outputs, not physical measurements.
Poses and routes are expressed in the authoritative world.json ENU frame; routes are the world-defined survey paths traversed ping-pong (no teleport).
The optical-visibility fault changes measured quality01 values themselves (see faultDelta), not just a label.
Stale and disconnected entries carry measured: null — frozen states are never dressed up as fresh readings.
This kernel emits measurements only; evidence acceptance belongs to an external policy evaluator (VQ-10).

failure.message: optical visibility fault applies only to the underwater role (underwater-rov), got role aerial-drone
severity must be one of moderate, severe, got "tidal"
durationMs must be an integer between 1000 and 120000, got 999999
resume is only valid while paused (state: running)
command pause has unexpected field: sourceKind; allowed fields: type, idempotencyKey

faultDelta.interpretation: Optical mean drops by the fixture factor (severe = 0.12); sonar stays at its own fixture baseline, confirming the fault is optical-modality-only and measured, not labelled.
